name.ja: ピカちんキット06 ティッシュ箱カメラ

description.ja: • 電池を使わずに待つだけで写真を撮りたいキミへ！
description.en: • For you who want to take photos without using batteries and just waiting!

description.ja: • 電池不要！　太陽の光だけで撮影できるスパイカメラ！
description.en: • No batteries required! A spy camera that can take pictures using only sunlight!

description.ja: • テレビ番組「ポチっと発明 ピカちんキット」に登場するティッシュ箱カメラが商品化！
description.en: • The tissue box camera that appears on the TV program "Pochitto Invention Pikachin Kit" has been commercialized!

description.ja: • 自然の力で激写！被写体に狙いを定めて数十分動かさずにじっと待つだけ簡単カメラの発明品！
description.en: • Photography with the power of nature! A camera invention that makes it easy to aim at the subject and wait for several minutes without moving!

description.ja: • ピカちん大百科に綴じられるピカちんシートも付いてくるぞ！
description.en: • It also comes with a Pikachin sheet that can be bound into the Pikachin Encyclopedia!
